purpose: Teach: 後述/費やす/沿う/起点/厳正/一味/ナマ/言い換え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の結論は後述の章で詳述しろ
lines.en: Ren — put the conclusion in the later chapters. Detail it thoroughly.
lines.style: Measured, direct instruction. Leans forward slightly. Expecting compliance without needing to repeat. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験に時間を費やす予定です
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to spend time on the experiments.
lines.style: Careful, slightly defensive. Nodding slightly. Wants to show he's thought this through. Speaking a bit quietly, as if reassuring.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の方針に沿う論文を書け
lines.en: Ren — write a paper that aligns with the lab's approach.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Clean delivery on 'aligns.' Matter-of-fact, like this is obvious. A senior person setting boundaries.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の起点となる仮説を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll verify the starting hypothesis for the research.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Slight pause before the verb — he's already thinking ahead. Respectful but not obsequious. Shows he's understood the direction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文審査は厳正だぞ
lines.en: Ren — the review process is rigorous. Don't mistake that.
lines.style: Sharp, warned. Weight on 'rigorous.' Not threatening, but clear: this is serious work. Eyes steady. The tone of experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。不正研究の一味と関わらないようにします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to keep my distance from anyone involved in research misconduct.
lines.style: Serious undertone. Nods firmly. A bit stiff — he takes the warning seriously. Speaking with quiet conviction, not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文付録にナマの実験データを載せろ
lines.en: Ren — put raw experimental data in the paper's appendix.
lines.style: Direct, no-nonsense. Expects him to know why. Delivered as instruction, not suggestion. Composed and final.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。難解な専門用語は分かりやすく言い換えて発表します
lines.en: Yes. I'll explain the difficult technical terms in simpler language when I present.
lines.style: Thoughtful closing. Slight pause after the initial assent — showing he's considering how to make this accessible. Soft finish, earnest intent clear.
